title: 2026 TCS New York City Marathon — race page
claims: The 2026 TCS New York City Marathon is scheduled for Sunday, 1 November 2026, at 8:00 AM in New York City.
There are five start waves, three start colours (blue, orange and pink) and six corrals per wave; wave and corral assignments cannot be changed.
The corral timeline gives corral opening times of 8:10, 9:05, 9:45, 10:25 and 11:00 a.m. and wave start times of 9:10, 9:45, 10:20, 10:55 and 11:30 a.m. for waves 1 to 5.
Only registered entrants and guides are allowed in Fort Wadsworth and the start area.
The only bag allowed into Fort Wadsworth is the clear official start village bag received at the Expo, and no bag may be checked at the start for transport to the finish.
There are more than 1,600 toilets in the start villages and corrals.
The race page publishes course, start and finish map PDFs and links an interactive Google map.
Live unofficial results and runner tracking are available in the NYRR App during the event, and official results are posted at results.nyrr.org after the race.
The TCS New York City Marathon is a World Athletics Elite Platinum Label race operating under World Athletics Rules.
To be eligible for prize money in any category, a runner must complete the course in 3 hours 10 minutes or faster.
The NYRR Pace Team leads groups between 6:40 per mile and 14:18 per mile, corresponding to finish times between 2:55 and 6:15.
The existing event records listed on the page are 2:04:58 for the Open Division men (Tamirat Tola, 2023) and 2:19:51 for the Open Division women (Hellen Obiri, 2025).
